source.title: Simulation dataset for benchmarking quantitative risk analysis methodologies for hydrogen refuelling stations

dataset_description.content: Simulation files and exported consequence, societal-risk and individual-risk results for seven QRA methodologies applied to an idealised hydrogen refuelling station.

access_observation.dataverse_api_observation: The public landing page and dataset/file API routes returned an anti-bot challenge during this review, so no file was parsed or transformed.

claim_boundary: This is an independently published, openly licensed simulation/QRA benchmark. It can support comparison of risk-method outputs and visualization context, but it does not validate a station-to-vehicle dynamic model, measured thermodynamics, accident frequencies or LLM recommendations. It must not be used as a measured holdout or as evidence for IJHE readiness.
next_action: If the custodian exposes the underlying files, inspect their schema and license-compatible use separately; retain the full-loop gate as open until a synchronized measured station-to-vehicle logger is obtained and frozen before scoring.
